mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS couple_id, inviter.id AS inviter_id, invitee.id AS invitee_id, inviter.investment_type AS inviter_investment_type, invitee.investment_type AS invitee_investment_type, inviter.birth_date AS inviter_birth_date, invitee.birth_date AS invitee_birth_date, inviter.kb_star_savings_eligible AS inviter_kb_star_savings_eligible, invitee.kb_star_savings_eligible AS invitee_kb_star_savings_eligible, inviter_survey.annual_income AS inviter_annual_income, invitee_survey.annual_income AS invitee_annual_income, inviter_survey.monthly_available_amount AS inviter_monthly_available_amount, invitee_survey.monthly_available_amount AS invitee_monthly_available_amount, inviter_survey.financial_knowledge AS inviter_financial_knowledge, invitee_survey.financial_knowledge AS invitee_financial_knowledge, common_survey.first_goal_type, common_survey.second_goal_type, common_survey.target_period_months, common_survey.loan_purpose, common_survey.has_loan_within_one_month, COALESCE(inviter_finance.available_balance, 0) + COALESCE(invitee_finance.available_balance, 0) AS available_balance, ( COALESCE(inviter_finance.has_high_rate_debt, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(invitee_finance.has_high_rate_debt, 0) = 1 ) AS has_high_rate_debt, COALESCE(inviter_pension.has_pension_saving, 0) AS inviter_has_pension_saving, COALESCE(inviter_pension.has_irp, 0) AS inviter_has_irp, COALESCE(inviter_pension.has_isa, 0) AS inviter_has_isa, inviter_pension.tax_eligibility_status AS inviter_tax_eligibility_status, inviter_pension.isa_eligibility_status AS inviter_isa_eligibility_status, COALESCE(invitee_pension.has_pension_saving, 0) AS invitee_has_pension_saving, COALESCE(invitee_pension.has_irp, 0) AS invitee_has_irp, COALESCE(invitee_pension.has_isa, 0) AS invitee_has_isa, invitee_pension.tax_eligibility_status AS invitee_tax_eligibility_status, invitee_pension.isa_eligibility_status AS invitee_isa_eligibility_status FROM couple c JOIN member inviter ON inviter.id = c.inviter_id JOIN member invitee ON invitee.id = c.invitee_id JOIN personal_survey inviter_survey ON inviter_survey.member_id = inviter.id JOIN personal_survey invitee_survey ON invitee_survey.member_id = invitee.id JOIN invitation_code invitation ON invitation.id = c.invitation_code_id JOIN common_survey ON common_survey.id = invitation.common_survey_id JOIN financial_summary inviter_finance ON inviter_finance.member_id = inviter.id JOIN financial_summary invitee_finance ON invitee_finance.member_id = invitee.id LEFT JOIN pension_isa_account inviter_pension ON inviter_pension.member_id = inviter.id LEFT JOIN pension_isa_account invitee_pension ON invitee_pension.member_id = invitee.id WHERE (c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId}) AND inviter.status = 'ACTIVE' AND invitee.status = 'ACTIVE'
